_meta.labeling_method: Architecture documentation + source reading. Labels created BEFORE seeing spectral output.

rationale.core: flask.sansio.app IS the core app implementation; flask.app wraps it. They are one architectural unit despite different directories. flask.ctx manages request/app contexts tied to the app lifecycle. flask.config is app configuration.
rationale.blueprints: flask.sansio.blueprints and flask.sansio.scaffold are the ASGI-compatible blueprint implementations; flask.blueprints wraps them. One architectural unit.
rationale.json: Self-contained JSON serialization subsystem with its own provider pattern.
rationale.cli: CLI entry point: __main__ delegates to cli module.
rationale.helpers: Cross-cutting utilities, debug support, global proxies, logging, signals — infrastructure glue.
rationale.http: HTTP layer: sessions, request/response wrappers, template rendering, view dispatch.
rationale.types: Type stubs — no runtime behavior, pure type annotations.
rationale.testing: Test client and utilities — used only in test suites.

notes: Cross-directory pairs: sansio.app<->app/ctx/config (core), sansio.blueprints/scaffold<->blueprints (blueprints). These are the pairs that directory grouping cannot recover but spectral might.
